terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff; labor and state reject closures as default while capital insists they remain available, with parties agreeing only to a sequenced test of alternatives via a KPI review gate.
Unresolved standoff; labor rejects forced layoffs and capital refuses to rule them out, with a proposed hierarchy prioritizing voluntary measures subject to economic sufficiency.
Unresolved standoff; labor demands binding guarantees through 2030 while management and owners view broad guarantees as incompatible with competitiveness, leaving scope undefined.
Unresolved; critical open questions remain regarding whether negotiated measures can close the structural cost gap and what specific savings are required plant-by-plant.
